Use the main tool T05 Cultural and Cross-linguistic Adaptation Process: first create a target context substitution table: institutions, identity categories, forms of address, language cues, regional scripts, and sources of local norms; use the secondary tool T03 Scenario-Stakeholder-Information Flow Template to reinforce: first add actor, affected party, third party, relationship, purpose, information/action flow, constraints, consequence.
